newsitem.title: GREECE: Old Greek FRNs to be based on gross T-bill yield.
newsitem.headline: Old Greek FRNs to be based on gross T-bill yield.

text.p: Greece's outstanding FRNs will be refixed using the gross 12-month T-bill yield after January 1 when a 7.5 percent tax on T-bills and FRNs goes into effect, Deputy Finance Minister Nikos Christodoulakis told Reuters in an interview on Wednesday.

"The refixing of outstanding FRNs will be based on the gross 12-month T-bill yield after January 1," said Christodoulakis. "We are against retroactive taxation." --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
